ohc: Vayyaas et mizbach hakketoret. ze hu mekom zichrono, ki penimi mehaamur acharav. uma shetztzivva Adonai alav meuchar mehakkol, katavti befarashat teruma befasuk "vechen taasu" (Shemot 25:9).
Chassalat parashat vayyakhel

Vayyaasu chol chacham lev. perush, hagam shehaosim rabbim hem, af al pi chen hayta hammelacha naaset keillu asaah adam echad. vehakkavvana baze, ki kesheyyaasu hammelacha rabbim, al kol panim yishtanne toar melechet ze mizze, velo tidme limlacha sheyyaasenna kullah umman echad. vehishmianu hakkatuv ki melechet hammishkan shelema hayta gam bivchina zo, ki hannoten chachma bahemma hishva otam behitbonnut hachachma shava, vedomim kullam leish echad. ulederech ze yityashshev taam amro bechol perate hammaasim leshon yachid, velo perash mi hu, ufeshita sheeno chozer al betzalel ki lo hu asa hakkol, vehaed hanneeman (Shemot 37:1): "vayyaas betzalel et haaron", ella yechavven el ose hammelacha, vehizkiram bilshon yachid lattaam shekkatavti.
Chacham lev beose vegomer. ulay sheyyirmoz shebbeemtzaut asiyyatam hammelacha uvesibbatah naasu chacham lev.

Vayyaasu vegomer. taam asher hechzir hakkatuv kol happeratim velo hispik lomar "vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe", al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 60) bechefel parashat eliezer eved avraham, ki mittoch shechaviva alav ketavah shete peamim, uchemo chen gilla hakkatuv beinyan maase hammishkan ki chaviv alav, velaze nichtav shete peamim.

rashi: Al teehav shena pen tivvaresh. ki tease rash:
targum: La terachem shinta dilma titmasken petach enach useva lachma:

rashi: Et hammishkan. yeriot hattachtonot hannirot betocho keruyim mishkan:
Et oholo. hi ohel yeriot izzim, heasuy legag:
Veet michsehu. michse orot elim vehattechashim:
ohc: Et hammishkan vegomer. hinne haderagat hammishkan, shehem yeriot hattachtonot, leheyot shemmesakkechin al hakkodesh hem behaderaga meulla meoholo umichsehu haasuyim mehaorot sheenam roim pene hakkodesh. laze lo amar "veet oholo" lehashevot elav, aval kol ma sheal yeriot hattachtonot hishva otam hakkatuv bemadrega achat, veamar veet michsehu lehashevoto begeder echad im oholo. velu yihye shettihye gedola ketzat haderagat haohel mehammichse, yodia hakkatuv ki en hefresh kol kach uvehadraga achat techashev. veamro et kerasav velo amar "veet", lomar ki haderaga zo shel hakkerasim enah begeder hashevaa im ohel umichsehu. veamar veet kerashav ki shavim hem begeder im hakkerasim. veamar et berichav ki enam begeder kedushshat hakkerashim. veamar et ammudav sheenam begeder habberichim. veamar veet adanav ki shavim behaderaga ammudim laadanim. vehammaskil al davar yire ki hassechel yakkir hahadragot shehem kemo shekkatavti.

rashi: Vechol ish asher nimtza itto. techelet o argaman o tolaat shani o orot elim o techashim kullam heviu:
Bigde hasserad. lechassot haaron vehashshulchan, hammenora vehammizbechot bishat silluk massaot:
Veet keleha. melkachayim umachtot:
Neroteha. lavetzayysh belaaz, bazichim shehashshemen vehappetilot netunin bahen:
Veet shemen hammaor. af hu tzarich chachme lev, shehu meshunne mishshear shemanim, kemo shemmeforash bimnachot (daf 86), megargero verosh hazzayit, vehu katit vezach:
Vayyakhel moshe. lemochorat yom hakkippurim kesheyyarad min hahar, vehu leshon hifil, sheeno osef anashim beyyadayim, ella hen neesafin al pi dibburo, vetargumo veachnesh:
ohc: Vayyakhel moshe vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam shehutzrach lomar vayyakhel, achar shehu davar haragil bechol et asher yetzavve devar Adonai. venire ki letzad sherau ki karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav, laze hutzrach lehakehil et kullan leval yimmanu ketzat mehammora, veze sheddikdek lomar et kol adat.

Od yirtze beamro et kol, al pi ma shepperashti befarashat teruma befasuk "meet kol ish asher" vegomer (Shemot 25:2) shebba lerabbot yetomim, ketannim venashim yeuyyan sham, vehu amro et kol shene ribbuyim, vetaam shello hizkir hashshelishi shehu shoa, ze eno tzarich likro lo, ki meatzmo bo yavo berinna bichlal kol yisrael.

Uvesefer hazzohar (Zohar 11 196:) amru shehikhil haanashim lehaferidam mehannekevot, letzad shehaya hassatan matzuy benam leval yazzikem chas veshalom, ad kan. umin hassetam lo yachchish shello nizdammenu hannashim lishmoa devar Adonai, uvifrat lehavi nidvat hammishkan, vechen hu omer (Shemot 35:22) "vayyavou haanashim al hannashim", ella yechavven lomar ki hikhil haanashim bifne atzman vehannashim bifne atzman, velo bau yachad velo amdu bimsibba achat. vehakkatuv ramaz haddevarim beyittur tevat bene shello haya tzarich lomar ella "et kol adat yisrael":

Elle haddevarim vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro elle haddevarim, uvemassechet shabbat (shabbat 97:) darash mikkan rabbi 39 melachot keminyan elle 36, devarim shenayim, haddevarim shelosha, hare 39, veze derech derash. od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar laasot otam velo hispik beamro "asher tzivva Adonai", veod kevan shello amar bemitzva zo ella inyan shabbat ech yutzdak leamer alav "taasu".

Achen yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (horayot 8,1) sheamru befasuk (Bamidbar 15:22) "ki tishgu" vegomer, shekkol hammode baavoda zara kechofer bechol hattora. umeatta hinne tzerichin kol yisrael letakken kol 613 mitzvot asher pagmu bechullan, vedavar ze hu rachok miggeder hahassaga. asher al ken baa mitzvat Adonai lahem sheyyizzaharu bemitzvat shabbat, veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 105) shakul shabbat keneged kol hattora, uvaze yetakkenu pegam sheppagmu bechol hattora. vehu maamar moshe kan elle haddevarim asher tzivva Adonai laasot otam, perush leshon tikkun, baze yetukkenu pegamehem shel bene yisrael. uma hem haddevarim? sheshet yamim vegomer uvayyom hashshevii vegomer. uvaze yityashshev ma shekkashe od, lamma chazar od letzauot al hashshabbat achar shekkevar tzivva kamma peamim, veod lamma tzivva alav samuch lemitzvat maase hammishkan. velidvarenu yavo al nachon, ki yetzav Adonai al tikkun heavar kede sheyyihyu muchsharim lishkon betocham, uvemitzvat shabbat sheshshekula kechol hattora hi takkanat avoda zara, keamro (Yeshayahu 56:2) "ashre enosh yaase zot", vedarshu zichronam livracha (shabbat 118,2) kol hashshomer shabbat kehilchato, afillu oved avoda zara kedor enosh mochalin lo.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (mechilta parashat tissa): rabbi elazar bar perata omer, minnayin shekkol hammeshammer shabbat maalin alav keillu asao? dichtiv "veshamru" vegomer "laasot et hashshabbat" ad kan. vehinne befarashat ki tissa perashti derachim rabbim beamro "laasot et hashshabbat", uderasha zo ze mekomah, vehu amro elle haddevarim asher tzivva Adonai laasot otam – perush haddevarim atzman shehem shabbatot attem osim otam, vehaven.

Od yirtze lomar, ki hagam ki mitzvat shabbat hi shemira mehammelachot ushevita veen kan maase littol aleha sachar, elle haddevarim asher tzivva Adonai sheyyihyu begeder maase littol alehem sachar. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat ki tissa (Shemot 31:16) taam laze. vedikdek lomar elle lishlol haddugema sheyyeshno bivchinat shemira levad eno kivchinat hammaase littol alav sachar.

Veal pi hammidrash (ykelavet shemauni 408) sheamru ki amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hakehel kehillot uderosh barabbim kede sheyyilmedu ledorot habbaim lehikkahel bechol shabbat vechulei, yitbaer hakkatuv al nachon: vayyakhel moshe vegomer vayyomer alehem elle haddevarim, perush hakehalat haeda uderashat hattora tzivva Adonai laasot otam. o yirmoz beamro laasot otam al bene yisrael, ki beemtzaut haddevarim mitkapperim kol avonotam kemaamar rabbi yishmael sham.

rashi: Chadal beni lishmoa vegomer. mikra katzar hu vezehu perusho: chadal beni lishgot meimre daat bishvil lishmoa musar:
Chadal lishgot kemo millishgot, vechen "vechadal laasot happesach" (Bamidbar 9:13), vechen "ki chadal lispor" (Bereshit 41:49):
targum: Perash beri ushema marduta vela tisge min maamare defumi:

rashi: Midde haavoda. yoter mikkede tzorech haavoda:
ohc: Marbim haam lehavi. kashe, vechi ra haddavar sheyyihye bet elohenu beotzrot zahav lechavod uletifaret? achen lo bau likbol al hammuva bet Adonai mehazzahav vechesef vegomer, ella al hammuva asuy melacha, shehu davar sheen tzorech bo gam omed lehitkalkel, kol sheyyesh de machsor, vehu amro marbim vegomer midde haavoda lammelacha, perush, marbim lehavi yoter mishshiur haavoda hatztzericha lammelacha asher tzivva Adonai. ha lamadta sheal perate haavoda hikpidu. vehaed lidvarenu maamar hakkaroz al yaasu od melacha litrumat hakkodesh, veamro vayyikkale haam mehavi velo amar measot, ki yomar hakkatuv davar shehukkar lachachamim haosim bammelacha vehi hahavaa.

rashi: Yitdot. litkoa velikshor bahem sofe hayeriot baaretz, shello yanuu baruach:
Metrehem. chavalim likshor:
Letz takke ufeti yarim. al makkot paro umilchemet amalek hechkim yitro venitgayyer (tanchuma, yitro 3):
targum: Limmikna timche veshivra mitarem vaaches lesucheltan denitbayen yediata:

ohc: Mishshene ketzotav. ulay sheyyechavven lomar shello asa hakkapporet shava vehaya makke bekurenas bechol rochav hakkapporet vechulei, ella bishat hahattacha hittich bemakom rachav keshiur hakkapporet, uvishne ketzotav hirba zahav shiur sheyyaspik lakkeruvim, uvaze yeduyyak amro mishshene ketzotav.

Veasa vetzalel vegomer et kol melechet vegomer. kashe, vahalo afillu lekichat hannedava adayin lo lakach laasot, veech yutzdak lomar veasa vegomer? achen hakkavvana hi shehechin kele ummanut hatztzerichin laasot bahem kol perate hammelacha asher tzivva Adonai laasot, ki tzerichin kamma perate kele ummanut. veze shiur hakkatuv: veasa vetzalel vegomer et kol melechet, perush, kelim shehem melechet maase avodat hakkodesh lechol asher tzivva Adonai, ki yesh avodat hammattachot vaavodat kele etz vaavodat haavanim vehaariga. vetze ulemad ma sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat mat:) ki ham melachot kullan hayu bammikdash, umehannishma mehakketuvim muvan ki beyom echad hechinu kol kele ummanut.

rashi: Ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai. li lemor lachem:
ohc: El kol adat vegomer lemor vegomer. tzarich ladaat lemi yomru bene yisrael. veulay ki letzad shello yedabber moshe im hannashim vehakketannim hagam sheyyihyu sham vetzivva lemor lahem haddevarim.

Veamro ze haddavar vegomer lemor yitbaer al pi ma sheamru besifre (parashat tetze) rabbi meir omer: "tov asher lo tiddor" – tov mizze umizze shello tiddor kol ikkar, rabbi yehuda omer: tov mizze umizze noder umeshallem, ad kan. veamru beferek 1 dindarim (nedarim 9.) shete okimtot: 1 shecholkim beneder, aval bindava mode rabbi meir sheyyehe nodev umeshallem, uchegon shehaya beofen sheeno ba lide takkala, uchemaase hillel shehaya mevi karbano keshehi chullin laazara vesham haya makdishah. vehav shecholkim bindava, velo amar rabbi yehuda ella nodev aval noder lo, venodev atzmo davka beofen sheeno ba lide takkala kannizkar, yeuyyan sham. lefi ze yechavven hakkatuv lomar al ze hadderech, ki letzad shekkadam lomar "kechu meittechem teruma kol nediv lev", im ken bindava medabber hakkatuv. laze amar ze haddavar perush, hannedava tzivva Adonai lemor otah, perush, davka bimtziut ze shehu shetztzivva Adonai shettomru nodev umeshallem, vehu beseder sheeno ba lide takkala. leokimta rishona yaale darkenu kerabbi meir uleokimta sheniyya kerabbi yehuda.

rashi: Vesavea yalin. hayyare et hashshem, shello yippaked beshum raa:
targum: Dechalteh delaha lechaye uman desavea minneh nevut vela nifkod bishta:

rashi: Ozen shomaat veayin roa vegomer. kelomar: maase yadav hem, vehu chafetz beozen shomaat musar veayin haroa et hannolad:
targum: Udna deshama veayna dechazya elaha ivre tarvehon:

rashi: Vayyikkale. leshon menia:
Mechoref atzel lo yacharosh. mippene hatztzinna yoshev heatzel veeno ose melacha veeno osek battora:
targum: Mitchasad atla la shatek veshael bechatzda velet:

rashi: Meshadded av yavriach em. mavriach em:

Ben mevish umachpir. derachav. al yede sheraata sara et ben hagar hammitzrit mesachek laavodat gillulim vegilluy arayot, garam ze shennishtallecha immo, "vayyera haddavar meod beene avraham" (Bereshit 21:11):
targum: Devayez laavuy umearek leimeh bera hu mevahatana umachperana:

rashi: Lechem happanim. kevar perashti, al shem shehayu lo panim lechan ulechan, shehu asuy kemin teva ferutza:
ohc: Et hashshulchan. en kedushshat hashshulchan shava likdushshat hakkodem lo, laze amar et, veamar bechol peratav veet ki madregat kullam shava bikdushsha, veet menorat hammaor betosefet vav lomar ki zo kedushshatah ukedushshat keleha shavim likdushshat shulchan vechelav, veamar veet mizbach hazzahav kemo chen begeder shave lammenora velashshulchan hu vechelav veshemen hammishcha vegomer ad masach happetach, bechol perat amar hakkatuv veet lomar shekkullan begeder echad hem, veamar et mizbach haola belo vav lomar sheeno begeder kedushshat hakkodem umekomo mochiach alav, veamar veet michbar shehu begeder immo, veamar et baddav sheeno begeder immo, veet kol kelav begeder echad im baddav, et hakkiyyor eno begeder mizbach hannechoshet, veet kanno begeder echad im hakkiyyor, et kale hechatzer enam begeder mizbach haola vechelav, et ammudav geder lematta mehakkelaim, veet adaneha veet masach begeder echad im ammudeha, et yitdot geder bifne atzmo, veet yitdot hechatzer veet metrehem kullan shavim begeder echad, et bigde hasserad hem devarim shemmechassim hakkodesh beferek hannesia, umadregatam lematta mimmadregat yetedot vegomer, et bigde hakkodesh hem madrega bifne atzman, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat teruma (Shemot 25:7) ki en moalim bevigde kehunna umoalim bechol kele hakkodesh, veet bigde vanav shavim hem likdushshat bigde aharon avihem, laze chibberam beVav hamechabberet.

rashi: Vehammelacha hayta dayyam lechol hammelacha. umelechet hahavaa hayta dayyam shel ose hammishkan, lechol hammelacha shel mishkan, laasot otah ulehoter:
Vehoter. kemo vehachebed et libbo (Shemot 8), vehakkot et moav (Melachim 2 3):
ohc: Dayyam vegomer vehoter. hem shene devarim hafekiyyim: im dayyam eno hoter, veim hoter eno dayyam, vechan en makom lomar "lo zo af zo" letzad sheshshenehem sug echad uvechina achat, veen derech laasot sug echad shene sugim ki yesh bannishma hachechasha. veod, lo haya tzarich lomar "dayyam" ella "vehammelacha hayta hoter lechol hammelacha". veod, kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shehare amar lemala "marbim haam lehavi midde haavoda lammelacha", ufeshita shello amru chen ad sheshshiaru, uma tzorech od lomar "vehammelacha" vegomer?

Veulay sheyyashmienu hakkatuv chibbat bene yisrael beene hammakom, ki letzad sheheviu yisrael yoter mishshiur hatztzarich, chash Adonai lichvod kol ish shettarchu veheviu, venichnas kol hammuva bet Adonai bimlechet hammishkan. veze shiur hakkatuv vehammelacha asher tzivva Adonai laasot bammishkan hispika lehikkanes betochah kol hammelacha sheasu bene yisrael, hagam shehoter, perush shehaya yoter mehatztzarich, hispik hammekabbel lekabbel yoter mishshiuro al yede nes. o al ze hadderech vehammelacha sheheviu hayta dayyam, lo chaser velo yoter, hagam shehayta yoter kefi haemet, vehu amro vehoter, ki naasa nes velo hotir.

Vayyaas et hammenora vegomer. timtza bechol hammaase sheyyedayyek leshon hammaase kilshon hammitzva, vetzarich ladaat lamma shinna bammenora, shebbammitzva amar menorat zahav vechan amar et hammenora.

Veulay ki lefi ma sheamru zichronam livracha behakkometz rabba (menachot koach:) ki hammenora baa gam mehammattachot, dichtiv "tease" lerabbot, laze amar Adonai menorat zahav lomar ki ma shehittir beribbuy tease eno ella ledorot, aval bammishkan meakkev lihyot zahav, velaze hismich menorat zahav belo hafesaka lomar sheen maasecha bammenora ella shel zahav. o al ze hadderech "menorat zahav" velo menorat shear mattachot hagam shehichshartim lecha, vedikduk ze en shayyachut lehodia bammaase ella hodia shekkiyyem mitzvat Adonai vaasaah zahav, vehaven:

rashi: Taman atzel yado batztzallachat. beyora chamma, shekkesheyyaavruha min haur ufinnuha rekanit, mechammem yado betochah. vedome lo "bishshelu bassirot uvaddevadim uvatztzelachot" (divrei hayamim 2 35:13). umishshum rabbenu yitzchak hallevi shamati: batztzallachat. milleshon targum "vayvakka" (Bereshit 22:3): "vetzalach", bishat hatztzinna vehaggelid, al shem shehakkor vehaggelid mevakkein vetzolchim hayyadayim. vaani shamati: batztzallachat. kera hechaluk, shekkorin 356 belaaz, kelomar: tomnah becheko (62):
targum: Atla dematshe yedeh beshachateh af la lefumeh mekarev leh:

ohc: Heviu vene yisrael nedava laAdonai. hattora meida al kelalut yisrael sheheviu nidvat Adonai, perush, davar harauy likkare nedava.

rashi: Veet parochet hammasach. parochet hammechitza; kol davar hammegen, ben milmala ben mikkeneged, karuy masach usechach, vechen sachta vaado (Iyov 1), hinni sach et darkech (Hoshea 2):
ohc: Et haaron. hitchil hakkatuv bammeulle shebbakkelim, kemo shehitchil bammishkan biriot shel shesh, shehem geder hakkedushsha hameulla shebbabbayit. veamro veet baddav, yodia hakkatuv ki shavim habbaddim legufo shel aron bakkedushsha, velaze timtza shetztzivva hakkatuv (Shemot 25:15) "lo yasuru mimmennu". veamro et hakkapporet, ki lo shava likdushshat haaron, vechen timtza shello haya kavua baaron vegam en azhara shello lahasiro. veamro veet parochet hammasach, hishva hakkatuv kedushshato likdushshat hakkapporet shehem begeder echad.

Vayyavou kol ish asher nesao vegomer. perush amro nesao libbo venadva vegomer, da ki yesh shete haderagot bammitnaddevim: haachat hu hammitnaddev birtzon nafsho kefi yechalto veerech mamono, velaze yikkare "nadva rucho", lishlol sheeno ose haddavar kemo tzaar benafsho, vehashsheni hu hammitnaddev yoter miyyechalto miggodel toviyyut libbo, velaze yikkare "nesao libbo", perush, shehallev menasseehu umaaricho beerech ashir yoter mimma shehu, latet davar yakar. velaze amar ki beyisrael nimtzeu shene sugim hannizkarim, ufatach bammeulle shebbishnehem veamar "kol ish asher nesao libbo", vedikdek lomar tevat ish leshon chashivut, ucheneged hashsheni amar vechol asher nadva rucho velo amar "ish" ki eno chashuv beerech harishon. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki lo hayu bechol hammitnaddevim ella shete haderagot ushetehen lishvach shennadvu belibbam velo asu haddavar bechesron retzon hallev, ella sheechad gadol mechavero. velaze dikdek lomar heviu et terumat Adonai lirmoz labbechina hanneelemet sheramaz beamro (Shemot 35:5) "yevieha et terumat Adonai" uchemo shepperashnu sham sheyyechavven el hammuskol, vedavar ze ikkaro benidvat hallev vehinne hu.

Ulechol avodato vegomer. yodia hakkatuv ki chol tzarche hammishkan, perush, kol hayg devarim shetztzerichin lammishkan vechulei, bau beatzman bindava, velo hutzrechu liknot davar mehem bechesef vezahav hammuva batteruma, vehaven:

rashi: Machashavot beetza tikkon uvetachbulot ase milchama. im bata lehillachem keneged hassatan, bo betachbulot teshuva utefilla vetaanit:
targum: Machshavta beetzta tittaken uvemadberanuta mitaved kerava:

rashi: Veoholiav. mishshevet dan min hayerudin shebbashshevatim – mibbene hashshefachot – vehishvahu hammakom livtzalel limlechet hammishkan vehu miggedole hashshevatim, lekayyem ma shenne velo nikkar shoa lifne dal (Iyov 34):
ohc: Ulehorot natan vegomer. perush, letzad sheyyesh chachamim rabbim shettihye chachmatam belibbam levad shello yedu lelammedah, laze amar ulehorot natan belibbo hiskil chachmat hallimmud. od ba lishlol ma shekkatuv beyoma lach,1 shel bet garmu lo ratzu lelammed al maase lechem happanim, shel bet avtinas lo ratzu vechulei, vehodianu hakkatuv ki al ellu yeamer (Mishlei 10:7) "zecher tzaddik livracha", ki hayu morim umelammedim kol harotze.

rashi: Masach happetach. vilon shellifne hammizrach, shello hayu sham kerashim velo yeriot:
Vayyaas betzalel. lefi shennatan nafsho al hammelacha yoter mishshear chachamim, nikret al shemo (Shemot Rabba):
Nevuv luchot. navuv hu chalul, vechen veavyo arba etzbaot navuv (Yirmeyahu 52):
Nevuv luchot. halluchot shel atze shittim lechol ruach, vehechalal baemtza:
Kavod laish shevet meriv. lanuach mimmeriva:
Vechol evil. sheeno shavat meriv, tiggale kelono:
targum: Yekara hu legavra deyatev dela dina vechol deshate mitztede:

rashi: Chur. benah shel miryam haya:

ohc: Vehem heviu elav od vegomer. perush, middevarim hannaaset bahem melacha, kemo shettomar matve shel techelet vegomer veshel izzim vechol happeratim asher teasena bayyadayim, veze sibbat akkavatam shello heviu ad achar yom o yomayim, ki asukim hayu umeviim melachtam yom yom, aval nidvat mamon hatztzericha kevar heviu beyom rishon befaam achat.

rashi: Tavu et haizzim. hi hayta ammanut yetera, shemmeal gabbe haizzim tovin otam (shabbat 74):

Bemarot hatztzovot. benot yisrael hayu veyadan marot sheroot bahen keshehen mitkashshetot, veaf otan lo ikkevu millehavi lenidvat hammishkan, vehaya moes moshe bahen mippene sheasuyim leyetzer hara, amar lo hakkabba kabbel, ki ellu chavivin alay min hakkol, sheal yedehem heemidu hannashim tzevaot rabbot bemitzrayim; keshehayu valehem yegeim baavodat perech, hayu holchot umolichot lahem maachol umishte, umaachilot otam venotlot hammarot, vechol achat roa atzmah im balah bammara, umeshaddalto vidvarim, lomar ani naa mimmecha, umittoch kach meviot levalehen lide taava venizkakot lahem umitabberot veyoldot sham, shenneemar tachat hattappuach orarticha (Shir HaShirim 8), veze shenneemar bemarot hatztzovot. venaasa hakkiyyor mehem, shehu lasum shalom ben ish leishto – lehashekot mimmayim shebbetocho lemi shekkinne lah balah venistera; veteda lecha shehen marot mammash, shehare neemar unechoshet hattenufa shivim kikkar vegomer, vayyaas bah vegomer, vechiyyor vechanno lo huzkeru sham, lamadta shello haya nechoshet shel kiyyor minnechoshet hattenufa, kach darash rabbi tanchuma, vechen tirgem unkelos bemechzeyat neshaya vehu targum shel marot, 776 belaaz. vechen matzinu vehaggilyonim (yeshaya 3) – metargeminan mechzeyata:
Asher tzavu. lehavi nidvatan:
Rav adam yikra ish chasdo. harebe yesh bene adam habbotchim el ohavehem hammavtichim otam chesed vekorim lahem beet dachkam:
Ish chasdo. hammavtiach lo laasot chesed:
Veish emunim mi yimtza. hammavtiach veose:
targum: Sugea divne nasha mitkaryan gavre merachamane vegavra mehemna manu mashkach:

rashi: Vechol achorehem. shel bekarim hallalu.
Boyta. el tachat hayyam hayu achorehem ponim, [shelasha] (shenayim) shebbatztzafon likrat shebbaddarom, veshel mizrach keneged shel maarav.
targum: Kaem al tere asar torin telata appehon letzifuna utelata appehon ledaroma utelata appehon lemaarva utelata appehon lemadincha veyama metaken ilavehon milela vechol achorehon legav:
Ukerontevan deal resh amudaya ovad shoshanta lakit beulama arba amin:

rashi: Vayfattach al halluchot yedoteha veal misgeroteha. hattachtonot al shenehem, pittach vechakak keruvim arayot.
Kemaar ish veloyot. pittach saviv kezachar unekeva hachavukim bizrootehen, ken pereshu rabbotenu.

Kemaar. leshon achiza vedibbuk, kezachar hammeure bannekeva, uferusho: ish veloyoto. ulefi mashmauto 'loyot' leshon 'dibbuk', shvldvra belaaz (halchama, rittuch), kemo loyot hayu sham, asuyot kimarat ish, vehammeare kemo shepperashnu.
targum: Ugelaf al luchaya ashdataha veal gedanfaha keruvin aryevan vetzurat diklin kevash chad umadbak sechor sechor:

rashi: Ushette chotarot. pvmyylsh belaaz (kaftorim).
Mutzak. tryshgytyr belaaz (yatzuk).

Chamesh ammot komat hakkoteret haechat. uvesof hassefer hu omer: shalash ammot, shaninu bammishna arbaim vetesha middot: shette ammot hattachtonot shel kotarot hayu shavot laammud, shello hayu bahen tzura, veshalash haelyonot hayu odefot lachutz, hammukkafot tzura, shenneemar: sevachim maase sevacha, kemin lulavin shel dekel hayu mukkafot. veomer ani, shello mana otan shette ammot hattachtonot besof hassefer, lefi shehayu shavot laammud, vehaammud tachuv bechoteret shette ammot.
targum: Vetarten kerontevan avad lemitan al resh amudaya mattach nechasha chamesh amin rumah dikronta chada vachamesh amin rumah dikronta tinyeta:
Matkela umatkela kayla vechayla merachakin inun kodam elaha af tarvehon:
Vaakem yat amudaya leulama dehechla vaakem yat amuda mimina ukera yat shemeh yachin vaakem yat amuda mismala ukera yat shemeh boaz:

rashi: Veovyo tefach. shulav udefanotav, ella sheetzel piv haya dak umerukka umeruddad, kemaase sefat kos sheshotin bo, umetzuyyar perach veshoshan.

Alpayim bat. sheshet alafim seim, shehabbat shalash sein, shenneemar: haefa vehabbat tochen echad lahem. nimtzeu chamishim umea mikve tohora, haarbaim meot, mea mikvaot, vehaesrim meot, chamishim mikvaot. veaf keshettechallek hakkol lefi midda sheshiaru chachamim amma al amma berum shalash ammot lammikve, timtzena ken, shalash ammot merubbaot, mea mikvaot, ushettayim haagullot, chamishim mikvaot, shehammerubba yater al haiggul reviit. uvedivre hayyamim ketiv: battim shelashet alafim yachil, ufireshu rabbotenu bemiddat hayyavesh, shehaggodesh haya shelish bevet hakkibbul.
targum: Vesumecheh fushecha vesifteh keovad sefat kas segalgal lakit beshoshanta teren alfin betin birtiva mechasel:
Dimhalech bitmimuteh tzadika hu vetuvehon livnohi vatrohi:

rashi: Ufihu mibbet lakkoteret vamala baamma. pihu shel kan, yotze mittoch pihu shel koteret, veole lemala amma govah, vehakkoteret hi gag hammechona asuy kemin kova meshuppa mikkol tzedadav, uveemtza nikbaat nekev agol amma vachatzi amma rochav beagol, useviv oto nekev kemin hekkef mechitztza, chatzi amma govah saviv, vechach meforash lematta bainyan, shenneemar: uverosh hammechona chatzi amma koma agol saviv. vehu karuy 'pi hakkoteret', vehakkan munnach al oto hekkef, veshule hakkan techuvin betoch pi hahekkef, ulemala hemennu hu bolet amma, vezehu sheamar kan: ufihu mibbayit lakkoteret umala baamma.
Ufiha agol maase chen. ufiha shel koteret agol, dugmat kan heagol.
Amma vachatzi haamma. rochbah beagol.
Vegam al pi miklaot. tzurat perachim.
targum: Ufumeh migav likrontehon uleela beamta ufumeh segalgal ovad kanta amta ufalgut amta veaf al pumah keliin ugedanfehon merabbein vela segalgelin:

rashi: Veshalash baamma komatah. shel mechona, levad komat haofan (perush: chutz min hakkan gufah) shehi yoshevet alav, amma vachatzi amma, vegovah hammechona amma vachetzi (arba baamma orech vego') haamma govah hayeta merubbaat, aval chatzi haamma hayeta agulla, shenneemar: uverosh hammechona chatzi haamma koma agol saviv.
targum: Vaavad yat besisaya asra dinchasha arba amin ureka divsisa chada vearba amin puteyah utelat amin ruma:

rashi: Vearba ketefot. kemo shepperashti lemala, vearba paamotav ketefot lahem, velo shenaan kan ella lomar umin hammechona ketefeha.
targum: Vearba katfin learba zivyan divsisa chada min besisa katfaha:

rashi: Veal hammisgerot asher ben hashelabbim. hayu metzuyyarot tzurot arayot, tzurot bekarim ucheruvim.
Veal hashelabbim ken. basis, lehoshiv hakkiyyor alav, millemala lammisgeret asher al rosham.
Umittachat laarayot velabbakar. hamrukkamin al hammisgerot shebben hashelabbim.
Loyot maase morad. loyot, kemin zachar unekeva mechubbarin ze baze.
Maase morad. meruddadin, kemin riddud tas dak, veen boletin beovyo, velo chakukim beshikkua. veyonatan tirgem loyot maase morad: madbak ovad kibbush, shvldvrsh belaaz (rittuch).
targum: Veal gedanfaya deven shelivaya tzior aryevan torin ucheruvin veal shelivaya kanta milel umilra learyevan uletorin midbak ovad kibbush:

rashi: Ushene turim. shel rimmonim veshel nechashet, harimmonim techuvim besharsherot hammakkifot et hakkoteret, kach meforash bedivre hayyamim, uvemishnat arbaim vetesha middot.

Lechassot et hakkoteret asher al rosh harimmonim. hare ze mikra mesoras, lechassot harimmonim et hakkotarot asher al harosh, vechen hayu hakkotarot asuyot lefi seder mashmaut hammikraot: kemin shene agganim hayeta kol achat, aggan hattachton bet kibbulah lemala, vehu karuy 'gulla', kemo sheamur bainyan: vegullot hakkotarot, vetirgemo yonatan: aggane keronettvan. haelyon kafuy al hattachton, bet kibbulo lematta, vehi keruya 'sevachaAdonai kema shenneemar beinyan ze: vehassevachot shettayim lechassot et shette gullot hakkotarot. nimtza rechava bemakom haddavek, umeshuppaat veola, umeshuppaat veyoredet, vehu karuy beten. vechen tirgem yonatan milleummat habbeten, millokovel divka. vegovah shette haagganot haelle arba ammot, vezehu sheamar: umaase shoshan baulam arba ammot. metzuyyarot hayu bam kemin pirche shoshannim, kederech hatztziyyurin bechotel haulamot, arba ammot govah, vehaamma hachamishit, hi koteret ketanna lemala min haggedola, hu shenneemar: vechoteret al shene haammudim.
targum: Vaavad yat amudaya uteren sidrin sechor sechor al serigta chada lechasaa yat kerontevan deal resh rimonaya vechen avad likronta tinyeta:

rashi: Mutzak echad. keshem sheyyatzak et harishona, ken yatzak et kullam.
targum: Kahada avad yat asar besisaya mattach chad meshachta chada ovada chad lechulehon:
Ushelach malka shelomo udevar yat chiram mitzor:

rashi: Veal rosh haammudim maase shoshan. chatzi amma berosh kol echad haya kotlo dak keshoshan, ushear haammud ovyo arba etzbaot navuv, lechach lo nimnet otah amma bitzikat haammudim bedivre hayyamim, lefi shello hayeta shava limlechet haammud.
targum: Veal resh amudaya ovad shoshanta ushelimat avidat amudaya:

rashi: Kemaase ofan hammerkava. tirgem yonatan: keovad gilgele merkava, ofan betoch haofan sheti vaerev, kemo sheamar bichezkel, bammerkava gavoah.
Yedotam. ayyshyl (tzir shel galgal).
Vegabbehem. bvyylsh belaaz (tabbur haggalgal), hem hannekavim.
Vechishukehem. hem agullim saviv, shehu kishuran.
Vechishurehem. zeroot haofannim, hattechuvim miggabbehem lechishukehem, shekkorin ryysh belaaz (chishurim).
targum: Veovad gilgelaya keovad gilgele merkevat yekara ashdathon vegabbehon vechofehon vechibbushehon kola mattach:

rashi: Vearbaat haofannim lemittachat lammisgerot. shehammisgerot miyyad ofan leyad ofan, kemo shepperashti.
Vidot haofannim. hu etz hattachuv baofannim, vekorin ayyshyl (tzir shel galgal).
Bammechona. devukim metzukim bammechona bitzika achat.
targum: Vearbea gilgelaya lemilra ligdanfaya veashdat gilgelaya bivsisa verumeh degalgal chad amta ufalgut amta:

rashi: Choresh. amman.

Vayyimmale et hachochma veet hattevuna veet haddaat. shelasha kele ammanut shehaolam nivra bahen, shenneemar: bechochma yasad aretz, konen shamayim bitvuna, bedato tehomot nivkau, bishloshtan nivna habbayit.
targum: Bar itteta armalta hu mishivta devet naftali vaavuhi gevar tzori uman beovada dinchasha veitmele yat chuchemta veyat sucheltana veyat data lemevad kol avida binchasha vaata levat malka shelomo vaavad yat kol avidteh:

rashi: Vayyaas asara chiyyorot. ketiv bedivre hayamim: et maase haola yadichu vam.
targum: Vaavad asra chiorin dinchasha arbein betin birtiva machsil lichiora chad arba amin kiora chad kiora chad al besisa chada laasar besisaya:
Man deyemar zakkay hu libbi veidachyet mechovti:
Uf beovadohi mityeda talya in deche vein teritzan ovdohi:

rashi: Et shene haammudim. sheheemid baulam yachin uvoaz.

Shemone esre amma komat vego'. uvedivre hayyamim hu omer: shelashim vechamesh amma komatan, sheyyatzak shenehem keechad, vehaamma hachasera, omer ani, chatzi amma hayeta lechol echad berosho, sheenah doma limlechet shear haammud, kemo sheamur lematta beinyan: veal rosh haammudim maase shoshan.

Vechut shettem esre amma yasov et haammud hasheni. limmed shehaya arba ammot al arba ammot agol, shekkol sheyyesh behekkefo shelasha tefachim, yesh bo rochav tefach, veovyo arba etzbaot, vehu chalul, kach meforash besof sefer yirmeyahu. vahare ze mikra katzar, peresh orko shel echad, veyilmad hasheni mimmennu, uferesh hekkefo shel sheni, veyilmad mimmennu harishon. vechen tirgem yonatan: vechut meshach tarten asre ammin makkif leh, vechen leammuda tinyana.
targum: Vetzar yat teren amudaya dinchasha tamne asre amin rumeh deamuda chad vechut meshach tarten asre amin makaf leh vechen leamuda tinyana:
Nesev levusheh metul daariv lechilyonay vela appe nuchereta mashkeneh:

rashi: Sevachim maase sevacha. hassevachot shehaya lahem, dome kemin kippa, shekkorin kvypa.
Maase sevacha. mukkafot hayu tzurot shel lulave dekel, kemo: veal sevacha yithallach, ugedilim hayu lahem kemaase sharsheraot.
Shiva lakkoteret haechat. shiva lulavin haya lehekkef echad lisvacha achat.
targum: Serigan ovad seriga kelian ovad gedilan likrontevan deal resh amudaya shava likronta chada veshava likronta tinyeta:

rashi: Chatzi haamma koma agol. hi mechitztza, kemo shepperashti lemala, shehi seviv hannekev vehaamma merubbaat.
Veal rosh hammechona yedoteha. hem sarne hannechashet haamurim lemala.
Umisgeroteha mimmenna. misgerot hattachtonot hutzeku immah, velo shechibberan leachar ken.
targum: Uveresh besisa palgut amta ruma segalgal sechor sechor veal resh besisa ashdataha ugedanfaha minah:
Memikna hu chamra veravyata shichra vechol deshage veh la nitchakkem:

rashi: Eser baamma missefato ad sefato. beemtzaito, shekkol rochav keli agol, beemtzaito hu.
Vekav shelashim baamma. zehu sheameru: kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelasha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach, hekkefo shelashim, verochbo eser, umittocho hu moded.
Komato. omko, uvedivre hayyamim hu omer, sheasao lirchitzat hakkohanim litbol betocho.
targum: Vaavad yat yama mattach asar amin misifteh ad sifteh segalgal sechor sechor vachamesh amin rumeh vechut meshach telatin amin makaf leh sechor sechor:

rashi: Misgerot lahem. raiti bammishna arbaim vetesha middot, hammisgerot kemin tavlaot.

Misgerot lahem. hammisgerot miyyad ofan leyad ofan, veyad ofan, hu etz hattachuv betoch haofan bannekev, vekaruy ayyshyl belaaz (tzir shel galgal). vearbaa haofannim bammechona, misgerot mikkan umisgerot mikkan, mearbaa tzedadin, uven zo lazo arba ammot rochav, umillemala 'seranim', kemo 'nesarim ', mul hammisgerot, vehashelabbim min hattachtona laelyona. umisgerot acherot. ben hashelabbim. keen melechet kare hammitta shel bene kefar, sheenan agullim ella bolet, latzur bahem arayot ucheruvim. veomer ani, shehashelabbim hallalu keen shelivot sullam, kemin maklot nechashet zekufin al hammisgerot hattachtona, kishnayim ushelasha ben makkel lemakkel, misgerot kevuot misheliva lishliva. veyonatan tirgem: shelivayya.
targum: Veden ovad besisaya gedanfin lehon ugedanfin ben shelivaya:

rashi: Gam mimmaal milleummat habbeten. shehu leever hassevacha, besof hassevacha beshuleha, hu baemtza bimkom haddevek (sheal hassevacha) (tzarich lomar: shehassevacha) medubbeket baggulla asher tachteha.
Veharimmonim matayim. rimmonim asuyin shette turim saviv, mechorazim beshalshelet, umakkifin et hassevacha.
Al hakkoteret hashenit. af ze mikra katzar, al haachat, vechen al hasheniyya.
targum: Ukerontevan al teren amudaya af milela milkavel divka di leibbar serigta verimonaya matan sidrin avidin leh sechor sechor al keronta tinyata:

rashi: Vearbaa ofanne. shenayim lefaneha ushenayim leachareha, kederech haagalot haggedolot.
Vesarne nechashet. yonatan tirgem: venisrin dinchash, hem hannesarim haelyonim mul hammisgerot.
Sarne. kemo nesarim.
Vearba paamotav. shel kan shealehem.

Ketefot lahem. boletot lemala min hannesarim bezaviyyot hakkan. vetachat hakkiyyor hayyoshev al hakkan, hayu hakketefot yetzukot (sefarim acherim: lelammed shemmittoch hakkan hayu hakketefot yotzeot bitzika achat, vehakketefot machazikot lakkiyyor shello yippol lematta letoch hakkan).
Meever ish loyot. mitztzad kol echad min hakketefot, haya loyot shel zachar unekeva metzuyyarot. meever ish. kemo ish el achiv haamurim bakkeruvim.
targum: Vearbea galgale nechasha livsisa chada venisrin dinchash vearba zivyateh katfin lehon milra lechiora katfin mattechin kichvash ovad dibbuk:

rashi: Ufekaim. vetzurat bein, tirgem yonatan.

Mittachat lisfato. beshalash ammot tachtonot shehayu merubbaot, shekkach shaninu baggemara deeruvin: shalash tachtonot merubbaot, ushettayim elyonot agullot, vei efshar lo lehachil alpayim bat shehem mea vachamishim mikve tohora arbaim, ella beinyan ze kemo sheppereshu rabbotenu beeruvin, elyonot merubbaot vehattachtonot agullot, i efshar lomar, dechi ketiv sefato agol saviv, lechach hu omer bappekaim hallalu eser baamma makkifin et hayyam saviv, shebbimkom ribbuo (hekkefo) arbaim amma, eser amma lechol ruach, aval bimkom iggulo i efshar lomar eser baamma saviv.
Shene turim happekaim yetzukim bitzukato. hakkol mutzak yachad, lo shechibber lo et happekaim achar yetzikatan al yede masmerot o al yede devek, shekkorin shvldra belaaz (halchama, rittuch).
targum: Vetzurat bein milra lesifteh sechor sechor makfin leh asar amin makfin yat yama sechor sechor teren sidrin detzurat bein mattechin beattachuteh:
Deit dahava vesugea dechefe tavata umane dikara sifvata didiata:

bart: Shor shehaya mitchakkech bechotel vechulei. patur min hammita. veim haya muad, kegon shehaya muad lehitchakkech bichtalim ulehappilam al bene adam, venitchakkech bechotel lahanaato vehippilo al haadam vamet, hashshor patur min hammita, vehabbealim meshallemim et hakkofer. hashshor patur min hammita, dichtiv (Shemot 21) hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat, kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor, ma bealim en chayyavin im hargu et hannefesh ad sheyyahargu bechavvana, kach hashshor eno chayyav ad sheyyaharog bechavvana. vehabbealim meshallemim et hakkofer, dichtiv im kofer, shehaya yachol lichtov kofer yushat alav, may im kofer, lerabbot hahoreg shello bechavvana lechiyyuv kofer:
Hinnichah bachamma. metzaara la shimsha velo saggi la binila karauy shehi bedelet sheyyechola laamod beruach metzuya bilvad:
Nichnas haroe tachtav. velo amrinan bichhay gavna shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav, shedderech haroe haggadol limsor laroe hakkatan shettachtav, ulefichach haroe shettachtav chayyav:
Nafla leginna. uchegon shehuchleka venafla beones. aval dachu otah chavroteha vehippiluha, meshallem ma shehizzika, deihu pasha bah, dahave leh laavrinhu chada chada:
Ma shennehenet. lefi hanaatah velo lefi hezzekah:

Shamin bet sea beotah sade. en shamin et haaruga levaddah, mippene shemmafsid mazzik, sheshshamin otah bechol shavyah, verachmana amar uvier bisde acher, vedarshinan melammed sheshshamin otah al gav sade acheret. ella sheshshamin bet sea beotah sade kamma hayta shava kodem shenneechla mimmenna haaruga hazzot, vechamma hi shava achshav, vehasheta lo meshallem kullehu dameha, demi shellokeach bet sea keshehi bitvuatah eno mezalzel bah bishvil hefsed aruga achat ki im davar muat:
Rabbi shimon omer achla perot gemurim. shekkevar bashlu kol tzarkan, meshallemet kol hahezzek. vehecha shayminan aggav sade, hecha daadayin lo nigmeru. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Hashsheni chayyav. vehu shemmasar lo rishon lashsheni keshehalach kissuy habbor lechassoto velo kissahu hashsheni:
Kissahu charauy venafal letocho. kegon shehitlia hakkissuy:

Nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya chayyav. shehaya chofer babbor veshama hashshor kol pattish venivat venafal babbor vamet, chayyav. veaf al gav dechevan demishshum gerama dekol hakkeriyya nafal hava lan lememar deistallak chiyyuva devor minneh veramya appeshiuta dekol hakkeriyya vehahu gerama bealma ufatur, afillu hachi chayyav, hoil uvetoch habbor nimtza hannezek:

Leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya patur. im nichshal hashshor mikkol hakkeriyya al sefat habbor venafal leacharav chutz labbor vamet, patur. shehare lo nimtza hannezek babbor, vekol hakkeriyya gerama bealma hu ufatur:
Venishtabberu, venitkaru. bichle shor shayyach shevira, haol vehammacharesha. bichle chamor shayyach keria, chavilat begadim umardaat sheal gabbav:
Ufatur al hakkelim. dichtiv (Shemot 21) venafal shamma shor o chamor, shor velo adam, chamor velo kelim:
Shor cheresh shote vekatan chayyav. shor shehu cheresh veshehu shote veshehu katan, chayyav alav im nafal labbor. aval shor shehu pikkeach eno chayyav alav, deibbae leh leayyone umezal:

Yatza yede chovato. dichtiv (Devarim 16) lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot, devarim habbaim lide chimmutz adam yotze vahen yede chovat matztza, devarim sheen baim lide chimmutz en adam yotze vahen yede chovat matztza:
Nitarev echad mehen bechol hamminim. nitarev echad mechameshet hamminim hallalu bishar taarovot, kegon kuttach habbavli veshechar hammadi:
Hare ze over befesach. al bal yerae uval yimmatze, im hinnicho virshuto:
Hannoder min haddagan asur bechol hamminim. dedagan kol demidgan mashma, vekitnit uzeraim mide demidgan hu:
Eno asur ella vahen. dedagan utevua echad hu. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vechayyavim bachalla uvammaasrot. ayde devae lemitne ellu chayyavim bachalla ufeturim min hammaasrot, veelu chayyavim bammaasrot ufeturim min hachalla, tana hacha vechayyavim bachalla uvammaasrot:

Vekotza challatah aruma. mafreshet challa umevarechet al haferashatah, vehu sheppaneha shel matta tuchot bakkarka vechol ervatah mechussa. vehaagavot en bahen mishshum erva leinyan beracha. aval haish eno yachol levarech arom, shei efshar lo lechassot ervato, shebboltim habbetzim vehaggid:
Mi sheeno yachol laasot issato vetohora. kegon shehu tame, veen sham arbaim sea sheyyitbol bahen:
Yaasenna kabbin. yaase kol issato kav kav, kede shello titchayyev bachalla veyitztarech lehaferish betuma:
Yaasenna vetuma. dehachi adif tefe mimma sheyyiftor issato min hachalla velo yihye vah chelek lashshem. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot. kol echad kammishpat hameforash beferek kamma demaasrot:
Ugemaran haggizbar. shennigmeru beodan tachat yad haggizbar:
Shebbishat chovatan hayu feturim. dichtiv degancha, velo degan hekdesh:
Chemet chalilin. chemet male ruach umesimin hachalilim befi hachemet veharuach yotze derech hannekavim umotzi min hachalilim kol shel shir:
Tehora min hammidras. delo chazya lishchiva:
Arevat pisonot. areva shemmeviin bah avanim ketannot verigve adama kede latet bannidbachim shel binyan. ufisonot leshon shekal pisa sheda veh deamrinan baggemara vesanhedrin gabbe markulis:
Bet shammay omrim midras. kasavre meshammeshet shechiva im melachtah. uvet hillel savre enah meshammeshet:

Shennisdeka temea midras. veim lo nisdeka enah temea midras, deomrin lo amod venaase melachtenu. aval keshennisdeka umotzia mashkin, enah reuya ella lishchiva. ufechuta mishshene luggim, o yetera mittisha kabbin, enah temea midras vaafillu nisdeka:
Venitpecha. mechamat geshamim mitnappeach haetz venistam hassedek:
Temea tumat met. kemo shehayta battechilla kodem shennisdeka, mippene sheyyesh lah bet kibbul. veenah temea midras, deenah meyuchedet lishkav aleha, hoil umishtammeshin bah belisha:
Bakkadim venisdeka. leachar shennitpach haetz venistam hassedek, hinnichah beruach kadim venisdeka:
Temea midras. dechazra lihyot reuya lishchiva velo lalush bah:
Ze chomer bishyare chele etz. ditchillatan en temein midras, ucheshennisdeku temeim midras:
Kele netzarim. sallim asuyin minnetzarim shel arava vechayyotze bahen:
Ad sheyyitchassemu. shettiggamer sefatan haelyona:
Af al pi shennashru siftotehen kol shehen. shennaflu siftotehen velo nishar besiftotehen ella kol shehen, tame:
Haya moshcho veyotze. patur mikkefel:
Higbiho. afillu birshut bealim. shehare hagebaha kona bechol makom:
Netano. gannav lakkohen, bechamesh selaim shel pidyon beno:
Haya moshcho. hakkohen o baal chov o hashshomer. umet birshut bealim:
Patur. haggannav mikkelum:

Sheppitchah mitztziddah. kesheppitchah millemala enah temea midras, deim yashav aleha uvaim lehishtammesh bah omrim lo amod venaase melachtenu. aval kesheppitchah min hatztzad, yachol lehishtammesh af al pi sheyyoshev aleha:
Bizman sheenah gevoha asara tefachim. kesheggevoha asara lo chazya lishiva chulle hay:
O sheen lah lizbez. dichsheyyesh lah lizbez mazzik layyoshev:
Nifchata millemattan. beshuleha. lo chazya letashmish, aval chazya lishiva:

Mippene shebbatal haikkar. ikkar hatteva hi asuya lehachezik beshuleha ma shemmesimim betochah, veal yadam hi nikret keli. vechevan shennifchatu shuleha uvatlu, batlu gam dafnoteha millemaalan veshuv enah mekabbelet shum tuma. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hannogea bakkoved haelyon. shene etzim agullim yesh laoreg, haechad shechut hashsheti karuch bo, vehashsheni shellefanav shekkol zeman sheoreg veholech korech bo hayeria hanneereget. ulefi shehem kevedim, nikraim koved. vechoved haelyon hu shellefanav, vechoved hattachton hu harachok mimmennu, shekkol hashsheti karuch bo:
Bannirim. hen chutim haarugin al hakkane, uvaavuran magbihin ketzat hachutim veosin derech sheyyelech bo haereg bachut:
Vekeros. masrek shebbo makkim al haariga umechabberim hachutim:
Bechut sheheeviro al gabbe argaman. leachar shennaaset harikma mesimin chutin aleha shello titlachlech, veotan chutin lo havu chibbur labbeged:

Uveira. hu ira haamur beferek kamma deshabbat (daf 11) velo gardi veira shebbeazno. vehi chaticha ketanna mitztzemer o mippishtan o mitztzemer gefen sheorgim betoch hammitpachot lenoy, vezorek oto vetoch hashsheti vechut shel erev karuch betochah, veyesh mehen shechorim vaadummim. veim eno atid lehachazirah, kegon shehi adumma veatta rotze lehachenis ira shechora, af al pi shello fesakah min habbeged lo haveya chibbur:

Benefesh hammassechet. chute haerev sheholchim betoch hammassechet kenefesh betoch hagguf, vechol davar shehaoreg noten betoch hammassechet letakken arigato, karuy nefesh. vehannogea bahen kenogea babbeged, dahavu chibbur:
Sheti haomed. shetztzarich adayin labbeged veomed leareg:
Uvechaful sheheeviro al gabbe haargaman. chatichat beged shettofrim al haargaman shello yitlachlech, have chibbur labbeged:
Ira sheatid lehachazirah. kidfareshna leel:
Batztzemer sheal haimma. veyesh sheggorsim haima veayin, vehakkol echad. vehu makkel aroch o kane shehannashim korchot bo et hatztzemer vetoot:
Baashvaya. batztzemer sheal haashvaya. veimma veashvaya shetehen litvot asuyot, ella shemmeshunnot zo mizzo betzuratan:
Tahor. deeno chibbur:
Pika. kemin iggul katan shel mattechet veyesh bo nekev, vehannashim notnot oto berosh happelech lehachebido. vekorim lo velaaz 388:
Ad shello ferah. kodem sheyyattirenna:
Mishshepperah. leachar shehittirah:

Veim shechato asur. baachila. dichtiv (Shemot 21) sakol yissakel hashshor velo yeachel et besaro, mimmashma shenneemar sakol yissakel hashshor eni yodea shehi nevela unevela asura baachila, uma talmud lomar velo yeachel et besaro, ella lomar lecha sheim kadam ushechato leachar shennigmar dino asur:
Hikdisho vealav mukdash. venafka minna dei mithane minneh maal:
Kabbim. kav kav bifne atzmo:
Venagu ze vaze. en hannegia metzaraftan lehitchayyev bachalla:
Ad sheyyishshochu. sheyyitdabbeku ze vaze kol kach sheim ba lehaferidam nitlash mizzo lazo:
Af harode venoten lassal. harode challot min hattannur leachar shenneefu venotnam bassal:

Hassal metzarfan lachalla. veaf al pi sheen noshchot. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer. veha dematzreche rabbanan neshicha verabbi eliezer negia, hanne mile letzaref shene issot yachad sheen bechol achat kashshiur, aval leinyan litrom [min] hammukkaf af negia lo vae, rak sheyyihyu semuchim ze laze. uveshilhe pirkin deamar rabbi eliezer noten pachot mikkabbetza baemtza kede litrom min hammukkaf, alma bainan negia leinyan mukkaf, tehora utemea shane, mippene shehu davar shemmakpid al taaruvto en hakkeli metzaref:
Hakkarim. asuyin lemalleotan tzemer o notza, veadam notnan tachat meraashotav:
Vehakkesatot. kemo charim hen, ella shehen arukkim ugedolim vechol gufo shel adam shochev alehen:
Martzufin. kemin sakkim shel or gedolim shennotnim bahen sechorot shemmolichin bassefinot:
Hare ellu temeim midras. dechol hane avide nammi lishchiva:
Kelusetor. kemin sal uchefifa shettolin befi habbehema, venotnim bah mispo useorim vehabbehema ochelet keshehi mehallechet:
Turemel. kis gadol shel or sheharoe noten sham kol chafatzav:
Keretit. sak shel or katan:
Rivtzal. chemet katan shel or shemmesimim bo vesamim:
Mizvada. keli shennotnim bo tzeda ladderech. targum tzeda zevadin:

Hare ellu temeim midras. kol ellu hashshenuyim bammishna, im yesh bechullan hashshiur hameforash bahen o yoter, metammein midras, dimshammeshin shechiva im melachtan. aval befachot mikkeshiur hameforash bahen, lo:
Nifchatu tehorin. shekkol ellu asuyin lekabbel, shehakkibbul hahu mechinam umazminam lihyot reuyin lemishkav umoshav, ucheshennifchat batal haikkar shehu hakkibbul shebbaavuro haya karuy keli:
Uvatla hattefela. shehi tumat midras:
Haacharonim meshallemim shelosha. leshor. uchegon shehuzemu acharonim techilla. dei ede geneva huzemu techilla, batla lah edut tevicha, dedilma bealim mecharuhu lo, vechi mittazzeme ammay meshalleme:
Batla edut sheniyya. vehu meshallem kefel mishshum edut rishonim. vehen peturin, deen edim meshallemin mamon ad sheyyuzemu shenehem:

Batla kol haedut. vehu patur vehem peturim. vaafillu chazru vehuzemu acharonim achar kach, en meshallemin, shehare batla edutan kevar vehuchchashu, kevan delo ganav lo tavach, veahachi lo michayyevu ella aimmanu heyitem shehusera gufa shel edut. vechol shekken im huzemu shenayim harishonim techilla, sheedut sheniyya batla. ella shebbizman shello huzemu ella echad, batlu shenehem. aval keshehuzemu shenehem, lo batla edut rishona ella meshallemin kefel:
Afar chutz laaretz habba visfina laaretz. bisfina nekuva ayre, verigve haadama sotmin et hannekev, sheen hammayim nichnasim bah:
Chayyevet bammaasrot. im zara vetzamchu hazzeraim beafar shebbetoch hassefina. veaf al pi shemmeafar chutz laaretz hu, hoil vehi nekuva hazzera yonek millachut afarah shel eretz yisrael:
Ematay bizman shehassefina gosheshet. nogaat begushe heafar, kelomar shehi devuka vaaretz:

Issa shennillosha veme ferot chayyevet bachalla. bayrushalmi mochiach ketzat sheen halacha kistam mishna zo, veissa shennillosha veme ferot petura mechalla. hilkach en lalush issa sheyyesh bah shiur challa beme vetzim o beme ferot levaddam belo taarovet mayim, hoil velo itbarir halacha i chayyevet bachalla o fetura:
Veneechelet beyadayim mesoavot. sheen ochel muchshar lekabbel tuma ad sheyyavou alav mayim o echad mishshiva mashkin, [uma] shello huchshar lekabbel tuma en hayyadayim mesoavot poslot otah:
Birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut hayyachid acheret. af al gav deen kan tzad reshut harabbim, chayyav. uvilvad im hifkir reshuto, otah sheppi habbor letochah:
Echad hachofer bor. hu asuy agol:
Shiach. aroch vekatzar:
Meara. merubbaat umechussa bekeruy, ella sheyyesh lah pe:
Charitzin. rechavim umerubbaim kimara, ella sheenan mekorin:
Neitzin. ketzarin millematta urechavim millemala:
Ma bor sheyyesh bo chede lehamit asara tefachim. distam bor hu gavoah asara tefachim:
Teva shennifchata millemalan. hakkissuy shellah:
Temea teme met. dechevan deshuleha kayyamim akkatti chazya letashmish. vedavka tumat met. aval lo tumat midras, delo chazya lishiva:
Nifchata millemattan. beshuleha. batal bet kibbul shellah utehora legamre:
Megurot shellah. otzarot shebbah, dehaynu chadarim shebbetochah shello nifchatu immah, temeot:
Tehora. vaafillu ikka arukka ushete cheraayim, hoil veen bedatam lehachazir. vechi mahane, davka vemakom shehakkol leadam echad:
Mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. aval lemafrea lo, dechevan dechillekuha parcha tuma minna:

Mittammet chavila. im persha hakkera min haarukka veomedet im hakketzara, have chibbur, veim nitmet hakkera nitmet hakketzara. keshem shekkeshekkullah shelema im nitma echad meavareha nitmet kullah, kach nammi keshepperash hakkera min haarukka veomedet im hakketzara, naaset chavila im hakketzara, ucheshennitmet hakkera nitmet hakketzara immah:
Umittaheret chavila. sheim hitbil hakkera im hakketzara en hakketzara chotzetzet aleha, ki hechi dela chaytza aleha keshemmatbilah keshehi shelema:
Vachachamim omrim mittammet evarim. velo chavila. deim nitmet kera, hi temea velo ketzara, deenah chibbur kishlema:

Umittaheret evarim. keshebba lehatebilah matbil hakkera bifne atzmah, velo chavila im hakketzara, shehakketzara chotzetzet aleha, deenah chibbur kishlema, dematbil mitta shelema tehora af al pi shello ferkah, aval hasheta defersha hakkera min haarukka lo have chavila im hakketzara, vetzarich lehatebilah bifne atzmah. vahalacha kachachamim. kach niret perush mishna zo min hattosefta, vechach pershuha rabbotay:

Chameshet revaim. shel kav chayyavin bachalla, dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) reshit arisotechem, veissat midbar hayta omer laggulgolet, vehaomer asirit haefa hu, haefa shalosh sein, vehassea shishsha kabbin, hare shemona asar kabbin beefa, vehakkav arbaa luggin, hare shivim ushenayim luggin. asirit shivim shiva luggin, vaasirit shene luggin hu betza vechomesh betza, shehallog hu shishsha vetzim. keshebbau lirushalayim vehosifu shetut al hammiddot nimtza shishsha luggin [hem] chamishsha, (velog hishshava) [velog hu] chamishsha vetzim, shekkol shishsha naasim chamishsha, uvetza vechomesh betza naaset betza. nimtza haomer shehaya vammidbar shiva luggim uvetza vechomesh betza, naasa virushalayim shishsha luggin. keshebbau letzippori vehosifu shetut al hammiddot shel yerushalayim, naasu hashshishsha luggin chamishsha. vehayenu chameshet revaim kemach. venikreu halluggin revaim, lefi shehallog hu rova hakkav, shehakkav arbaa luggin:
Hen useoran. hasseor shennotnin letochan:
Vesubban. hu haddak:
Mursanan. hu haggas. kullan mitztarfin im hakkemach lehashelim hashshiur, shekken ani ochel pitto beissa meorevet im subbin umursanan:
Nittal mursanan mittochan vechazar letochan hare ellu feturim. sheen derech issa lehachazir mursan letochah leachar shennittal mimmenna:
Nittela achat meraglav tahor. delo chazi leshulchan, shehare eno rauy leechol alav:
Nittela shelishit tame. sherauy leechol alav kemo al gabbe tavla. vehu sheyyachshov leechol alav:
Eno tzarich machshava. dechevan sherauy leechol alav hare hu mekabbel tuma:
Vechen haddelufki. dino kedin hashshulchan, ucheshem shennechleku bashshulchan kach nechleku baddelufki. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hachevel hayyotze min hammitta. ma shennishar mimmennu leachar sheggamar hasserug:
Ad chamishsha tefachim tahor. delo chazi lemidi letzorech hammitta, vela chashiv lah yad:

Mechamishsha vead asara tame. dachazi likshor bah happesachim. shehayu regilim likshor sham happesach bachevel shebbechare hammitta kede sheyyihye mezumman lahem. vachazi nammi leshalshel bo et hammitta, kelomar lehoridah min haaliyya laggag, i nammi lehoridah el hammikve lehatebilah keshennitmet:
Measara velachutz tahor. dema sheyyesh bachevel yoter measara eno meshammesh letzorech hammitta kelum:
Zete masik. zetim shebbaal habbayit melakket. ulekitat hazzetim keruya mesika:
Zete nikkuf. zetim sheaniyyim melakketim. kema deat omer (yeshaya 17) kenokef zayit shenayim shelosha gargerim, vehem peturim min hammaaser:
Inneve vatzir. shechayyavim bammaaser:
Im inneve ollot. sheppeturim min hammaaser:
Im yesh lo. tevel acher kayyotze vaze, motzi mimmennu lefi cheshbon keshiur ma shetztzarich lehotzi mizzete masik o meinve vatzir shechayyavim bammaaser:
Veim lav. im en lo tevel acher, roim oto keillu kullo tevel, umotzi teruma uterumat maaser al hakkol:
Vehashshear maaser. rishon:

Umaaser sheni. o masar ani, en motzi ella lefi cheshbon. velo shello yafrish ella lefi cheshbon, deha i efshar lehaferish terumat maaser ad sheyyafrish techilla maaser al hakkol, veod i lo mafrish maaser al hakkol hare kol ma shemmeasser yesh bahen chullin lefi cheshbon, venimtza mafrish min happatur al hachiyyuv, ella kol hammaasrot tzarich lehaferish al hakkol, aval eno tzarich litten lallevi veleani ella lefi cheshbon, vehashshear mearev im perotav. vechen maaser sheni eno tzarich lifdot ella lefi cheshbon, aval teruma uterumat maaser shehen bemita. keshemmafrish al hakkol nimtzeu chullin shebbahen medummain, vetzarich sheyyitten hakkol lakkohen:
Safek chayyav. mishshum dahave sefek issura, ulechumra, umafrish challa umochrah lakkohen:
Veen chayyavin aleha chomesh. zar haochlah eno meshallem et hachomesh, aval hakkeren meshallem, detashlume teruma kappara ninhu, hilkach mafrish tashlumin, umechapperim missafek, umochran lakkohen:

Achar hakkerima vattannur. desavar rabbi akiva en gemar melachtah shel challa ad sheyyikremu fene happat battannur, vezo hi onatah lachalla, hilkach im nitgayyer kodem sheyyikremu fene happat battannur, chayyav bachalla. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Petura min hachalla. sheen gilgulo shel yisrael mechayyev haissa shel oved kochavim. vechen issa shel yisrael en gilgul haoved kochavim potartah:
Im en beshel yisrael keshiur. shechayyavin lehaferish mimmenna challa, shehen chameshet revaim:

Megera. barzel male pegimot shemmenasserim bo halluchot vehannesarim. uvelaaz 74. veyesh lammegera shene etzim, echad mitztzad ze veechad mitztzad ze, shebbahem tofes charash etzim beshaa shemmenasser halluchot, vehaetzim hallalu hen bet yad lammegera. veim nitmet hammegera, hannogea bahen tame, dahavu la yadot:
Bachut uvammeshicha. berosh haetzim hallalu shehen bet yad, koshrin chut umeshicha vechevel sheholech al orech hammegera umechabber ben shenehen umaamido:
Baamma. etz aroch shebbeemtza ellu hashshene etzim veholech al orech hammegera, karuy amma:
Uvassenifin. etz katan natun min hachut vehammeshicha ad haamma, uvo fotlin vegodlin hachut vehammeshicha, verosho echad betoch hachut verosho echad baamma. ufeamim yasim shenayim:

Machbesh. makom yesh lo lecharash etzim shekkovesh veotzer sham haetzim haakumim vehalluchot haakummot vehaakushshot kede sheyyityashsheru, vechen otzer sham haetzim vehannesarim shello yitnoau lechan ulechan ad sheyyetakkenem limlachto:

Kashtanit. kemin keshet katan shel etz shettochavim bo varzel shel makdeach kesherotze likdoach bo, vehaadam ochez bakkeshet umegalgel bo et habbarzel. veim habbarzel tame lo nitma hakkeshet, delo have chibbur, sheddarkam haya shello lechabber hakkeshet babbarzel:
Massar haggadol. megera gedola sheasuya lenasser korot, veosim lah kemin merubba meetzim dakkim, vehammegera vaemtza, veoto hamerubba karuy malben:
Tahor. sheen tame ella mekom achizat bet yad bilvad. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bayyeter. chevel hakkeshet. leshon konnu chitztzam al yeter (tehillim 11):
Af al pi shehi metucha. af al pi shehachetz bayyeter uvakkeshet umetucha lirot bah venitma hachetz, lo nitma hakkeshet vehayyeter, sheen hachetz chibbur lekeshet veyeter:
Eshut. beriyya sheen lah enayim. hattinshemet metargeminan eshuta. vetzadin otah lefi shemmafsedet et hassadot:
Tehora. sheenah chashuva cheli:
Kol zeman shehi metucha. vehachetz shel barzel bah, im nitma hachetz nitmet hammetzoda. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mishpelet. kuppa gedola shemmolichin bah hazzevel vehaashpa:
Shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim. shezzehu shiurah littaher keshennikkeva bemotzi rimmon:
Rabbi meir metamme. af al pi shehi tehora mishshear tumot, temea hi midras, sheruya lishiva:
Vachachamim metaharin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hashshulchan vehaddelufki. keli etz shemmesimin bo tzelochiyyot vaashishot veochalin umashkin, umimmennu notlin umesimin al hashshulchan:
Veshiyyer bahen mekom hannachat hakkosot. shello nifchat o shello chippan. dei hava kullo mechuppe shayish, haya tahor kichle avanim, devatar chippuy azlinan:
Mekom hannachat chatichot. shel lechem veshel basar. deim en bashshulchan mekom hannachat chatichot, lav shulchan hu velav delufki hu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Issa shettechillatah sufganim. kegon issa shebbelilatah rakka:
Vesofah sufganim. shemmetaggenim otah beshemen udevash, o mevashshelah bemayim:
Techillatah issa vesofah sufganim. shebbelilatah ava veachar kach metaggenim otah beshemen udevash o mevashshelah bammayim:
Techillatah sufganin vesofah issa. belilatah rakka, veofe otah battannur:
Kenuvekaot. lechem shemmachazirim oto lesalto, veosim mimmennu maachol lattinokot:
En megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael. mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael, shemmafsidin et hazzeraim:
Aval megaddelin besureya. aratzot shekkavash david. delav shemeh kibbush, velo chayshinan bah leyishshuv. veim yafsidu sedot acherim, yeshallemenna:
En megaddelin tarnegolim birushalayim mippene hakkadashim. sheochlin sham. vederech tarnegolim lenakker baashpa, veshemma yaviu etzem [kisora] min hashsheretz vitammeu et hakkadashim:
Velo. yegaddelu kohanim tarnegolim bechol eretz yisrael:
Mippene hattohorot. shehakkohanim ochlim teruma utzerichim leshamrah betohora:

Chazirim. mefaresh taama baggemara, keshetztzaru malche chashmonay ze al ze hayu regilim bechol yom shehayu ellu shebbachutz maalim lahem temidim leellu shebbifnim. yom echad heelu lahem chazir, kevan shehiggia lachatzi choma naatz tzipparnav bachoma venizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa. beotah shaa amru arur hamegaddel chazirim:
Et hakkelev. mippene shennoshech umenabbeach umappelet ishsha miyyirato:
Nishbim. pachim. shello yillachdu bahem yone bene hayyishshuv:
Sheloshim ris. arbaa milin:
Ochlin aray ad shettitgalgel. shettitarev yafe, lefi sheen shem issa aleha kodem gilgul:
Vetittamtem basseorim. lefi sheissat hasseorim mitparedet veenah mitarevet yafe keissa shel chittim, ella metamtem bayyad:
Chayyav mita. denigmera melachtah, vetevel hu bemita:
Magbahat challatah. takkanat chachamim hi beissa tehora lemaher lehaferish challa betohora, shemma tittamme haissa, deikkar mitzva hi lehametin ad achar gemar lisha:

Uvilvad sheyyehe sham chameshet revaim kemach. shennitarvu vemayim, divfachot mehen lo higgia haissa lichlal chiyyuv challa. veit sefarim degarse uvilvad shello yihye sham chameshet revaim kemach, kelomar shello yishshaaru chameshet revaim kemach shello nitarvu vemayim, deim nisharu chameshet revaim lo nifteru bachalla shehifrish kodem shennitgalgelu. uvayrushalmi mochiach sheim amar hare zo challa al hasseor veal haissa, veal hakkemach hannishar lichshettitgalgel haissa chullah titkaddesh zo shebbeyadi leshem challa, hare ze muttar. vechen yelammed adam betoch beto lannashim lomar ken keshemmafrishot challa miyyad achar gilgul haissa kodem arichat hallechem:
Nissa hazzav al hammitta veal hammizran. lav davka nissa al hammizran, ella nissa hazzav al hammitta shehammizran karuch sevivoteha veyotze mimmenna:

Metamme shenayim ufosel echad divre rabbi meir. rabbi meir letaameh deamar leel daafillu hammizran yotze min hammitta kol shehu vaafillu tuva have chibbur lammitta umetamme shenayim ufosel echad, kammitta atzmah. shekkol shehazzav nissa alav venaasa mishkav umoshav shel zav, have av hattuma, vehannogea bo have rishon, verishon ose sheni, vesheni ose shelishi lifsol et hatteruma bilvad aval lo letamme. vehayenu metamme shenayim dehaynu rishon vesheni, ufosel echad vehu shelishi shehu fasul batteruma bilvad, vehammizran kol zeman shello perash min hammitta chashiv keav hattuma umetamme shenayim ufosel echad, aval leachar shepperash lo have ella chivlad hattuma umetamme echad ufosel echad, kedin nogea bemishkav hazzav:

Rabbi yose omer vechulei. rabbi yose letaameh deamar leel [ad] asara tefachim vetu lo. hilkach ze shebbetoch asara chashuv chibbur lammishkav umetamme shenayim ufosel echad kol zeman shello perash, aval ma shechutz laasara lo chashuv chibbur lammishkav, vedino keferash, dimtamme echad ufosel echad:

Nissa al hammizran measara velifnim temea. garsinan, velo garsinan tame. vehachi ferusha, nissa hazzav al hammizran hayyotze min hammitta, im nissa measara velifnim letzad hammitta, hammitta temea midras, dechevan dechol asara chashive chibbur lammitta, keshennitma mizran nitmet hammitta. aval measara velachutz delo havu chibbur lammitta, tehora hammitta velo nitmet [betumat] hammizran. kach niret beenay perush mishna zo. vegirsat rabbotay degarse tame vetahor uferushan, lo nitkabbel li. vechen divre harambam shekkatav beferush mishna zo lo nichnesu beaznay kelal. vedikdakti achar kach bechibburo behilchot kelim perek 21 [halacha 9], nire li sheshsham chazar bo uferesh mishna zo kemo shepperashtiha kan:
Hammadlik et haggadish. shehidlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero:
Rabbi yehuda omer yeshallem kol ma shebbetocho. derabbi yehuda mechayyev al nizke tamun baesh, delet leh derasha deo hakkama ma kama geluya af kol galuy:

Vachachamim omrim eno meshallem ella gadish vechulei. deit lehu derasha deo hakkama, ufatre al nizke tamun baesh. ella shemmeshaarin mekom hakkelim keillu hu gadish, umeshallem gadish keshiur gufan shel kelim. umiddekaamre sefa umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira shehu meshallem kol ma shebbetochah, muchach baggemara shennechleku rabbi yehuda vachachamim gam bemadlik betoch shel chavero, sherabbi yehuda savar keshehidlik beshel chavero meshallem kol ma shebbetocho vaafillu arnaki. verabbanan savre kelim sheddarkan lehatemin baggadish kegon morigin uchele bakar hu dimshallem, kelim sheen darkan lehatemin baggadish lo meshallem. vahalacha kachachamim:

Haya gedi kafut lo chayyav. devaale chayyim nammi itrabbu meo hakkama. umishshum dekam leh bidrabba minneh lekka lemiftereh, deeno chayyav mita al haeved, hoil veeno kafut haya lo livroach, ufatur alav mimmita umin hattashlumin. aval im haya eved kafut lo, patur afillu al haggedi veal haggadish, dechayyav mita al haeved vekam leh bidrabba minneh. uvigdi lo shane lan ben kafut leeno kafut. veayde denakat beeved nakat bigdi:

Bemadlik et habbira. demadlik betoch shel chavero hu, vehave kimabbed bayyadayim. vaafillu hachi taama mishshum dederech bene adam lehanniach kelim babbattim. aval begadish deen derech bene adam lehanniach ella kegon morigin uchele bakar, af al gav deadlik letoch shel chavero, eno meshallem allibba dachachamim ella devarim sheddarkan lehatemin baggadish:
Ad shello gilgela ufedaattah. uleachar sheppedaatta gilgela, chayyevet, kevan devishat haggilgul lo hayta hekdesh:
Shebbishat chovatah hayta fetura. degilgul hekdesh poter, dichtiv arisotechem, velo issat hekdesh:
Shennittelu chippuyav. leshon chafe fotachat, kemin shinnayim yotzim mikkol tzad bechisse shel kalla, vaasuyin kede sheyyismechu alehen:
Bet shammay metammein. deakkatti chazi lishiva:
Uvet hillel metaharin. delo chazi lechalla, vehave chenishbar:

Af malben hakkisse tame. kelomar, af malben hakkisse bifne atzmo velo hakkisse uvelo chippuyav tame, kol shekken shehakkisse velo chippuyav tame. malben, tzurat levena merubbaat osim al hakkisse veyoshvim alav:
Kisse shekkevao vaareva. hevi chisse mimmakom acher ukevao vaareva derech yeshivato. vaareva enah temea midras, dechazya lelisha:
Bet shammay metammein. delo vatel kisse legabbe areva:
Uvet hillel metaharin. mimmidras. devatel kisse legabbe areva. aval kisse heasuy baareva atzmah modu vet shammay levet hillel detahor:
Veshammay omer. af kisse heasuy baareva atzmah tame midras:
Shor hayetomim. sheen lahem appotroppos:
Veshor haappotroppos. hashshor shel yetomim hu, ella sheal haappotroppos leshamro:
Hare ellu chayyavin. deshiva shor ketuvim bapparasha benogeach adam. chad legufeh, veshishsha leshishsha shevarim hallalu:

Rabbi yehuda omer shor hekdesh shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshim peturim min hammita. afillu nagach veachar kach hikdish, nagach veachar kach met hagger, haya poter rabbi yehuda. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Venaal befanav karauy. bedelet sheyyechola laamod beruach metzuya. vehayenu shemira pechuta:
Umuad patur. mitztzad haadaa shebbo. aval tzad tammut bimkomah omedet. umeshallem chatzi nezek ketam. dichtiv velo yishmerennu gabbe muad, ha shemaro kol dehu patur mitztzad haadaa:

Rabbi eliezer omer, en lo shemira. lammuad ella sakkin. ad sheyyishchatennu. veshalosh machalokot baddavar. lerabbi meir bishmira pechuta chayyav uvimulla patur. ulerabbi yehuda bishmira pechuta nammi patur mitztzad haadaa shebbo, aval chayyav al tzad tammut shebbo, ad sheyyishmerennu shemira meulla. ulerabbi eliezer bimulla nammi chayyav. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. umihu lechattechilla mitzva lishchot shor hammuad kede lesallek hahezzek:
Kullah temea midras. vechol zeman shello perash hammizran min hammitta have chammitta atzmah kidfareshit:
Vehammizran magga midras. umetamme echad ufosel echad, kedin kol nogea beav hattuma:

Halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehahefker. peturim min hammaasrot. dichtiv (Devarim 14) uva hallevi ki en lo chelek venachala immach, mimma sheyyesh lecha veen lo atta chayyav litten lo, yatzu ellu sheyyesh lo immach:

Umotar haomer. shehaomer haya va mishshalosh sein, umotziin mimmennu issaron solet menuppe bishlosh esre nafa, vehashshear nifde veneechal lechol adam. vechayyav bachalla ufatur mimmaaser, lefi shebbishat meruach haya shel hekdesh:

Utevua shello hevia shelish. chayyevet bachalla, sheaf hi vaa lide chimmutz, vechol davar habba lide chimmutz lechem ikre vechayyav bachalla. ufetura min hammaasrot, divmaasrot ketiv (Devarim 14) tevuat zarecha, davar shezzorim oto vetzomeach, vehay i zare leh lo tzamach:

Tevua shello hevia shelish petura min hachalla. dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) kitrumat goren ken tarimu otah, ma teruma enah baa mittevua shello hevia shelish, af challa enah baa mittevua shello hevia shelish. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Safsal. daf rachav vearoch, berosho echad takua mittachtav daf gavoah vechen berosho hashsheni, kede lehagebiho min hakkarka sheyyihye rauy leshev alav:
Nittal hashsheni tahor. velo dame leshulchan dichshennittelu shalosh raglav tame, desafsal shennishberu shene rashav lo chazi lishiva, shehayyoshev alav keyoshev al gabbe karka:
Im yesh bo gova tefach tame. shehaddaf haav tefach chazi lishiva:
Sherafraf. safsal lahadom raglav shel adam:
Hakkisse shellifne kattedra. dino chishrafraf:
Hakkones. patur. deha netarah umay have leh lemeevad:
Hotziuha listim. af al gav delo hotziuha mammash ella sheamdu befaneha ad sheyyatza, have keillu hotziuha beyadayim vechayyavim:

Mecharo chutz meechad mimmea shebbo. gannav shemmachar kol hashshor chutz middavar muat shebbo, min haddevarim hannittarim immo bashshechita, patur, dichtiv (Shemot 21) utevacho o mecharo, ad sheyyimkor kol haddevarim hannittarim battevicha. laafoke sheim hishir gizzoteha o karneha, delo have shiyyur, velo miftar behachi:
Hannocher. koro minnechirav ad libbo:
Vehameakker. oker simanim, patur. vaafillu lerabbanan deamre shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, deha lav shechita hi kelal:

Al pi ed echad. af al gav demilleta difshita hi deen meshallem arbaa vachamishsha al pi ed echad, ha kamashma lan deal pi atzmo dumeya deal pi ed echad, ma ed echad i ate ed echad batar hachi mitztaref bahadeh umichayyav, al pi atzmo nammi i atu edim batar hodaato mechayyeve leh, demode biknas veachar kach bau edim chayyav. vehane mille beomer lo ganavti, uvau edim shegganav, vechazar veamar tavachti umacharti, uvau edim achar kach shettavach umachar, chayyav, shehare kesheomer tavachti umacharti eno mechayyev atzmo bichlum, sheyyodea hu shemmode biknas patur, veen kan hodaa shel kelum. aval beamar ganavti uvau edim shegganav, patur. dechiyyev atzmo leshallem keren miha behodaato, hilkach hodaa gemura hi ufatur mikkefel, af al pi sheachar kach bau edim:
Umet aviv. vehu yorsho, velo haveya tevicha kullah beissura:
Ganav vehikdish. ki ka tavach dehekdesh ka tavach velo divalim:

Rabbi shimon omer kadashim shechayyav beacharayutam vechulei. rabbi shimon lav ammilleteh detanna kamma kae velo paleg aleh beganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar. ella shaminhu rabbi shimon lerabbanan beducheta achariti deamre haggonev hekdesh mibbet bealim patur, dichtiv (Shemot 22) vegunnav mibbet haish, velo mibbet hekdesh, vaala kae rabbi shimon veomer kadashim shechayyav beacharayutan chayyav, dekarinan beh vegunnav mibbet haish, dechevan dehabbaal chayyav beacharayutam ki ka tavach demareh ka tavach. uvekadashim shechayyav beacharayutan nammi lo mechayyev rabbi shimon tashlume arbaa vachamishsha ella kesheshshechatan temimim bifnim leshem bealim ella shennishpach haddam, o sheshshechatan baale mumin bachutz. veaf al pi shello nifdu, savar kol haomed lippadot kefaduy dame vehaveya shechita reuya. aval im shechatan temimim bachutz haveya shechita sheenah reuya. veshaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar shechita sheenah reuya lav shemah shechita veeno chayyav aleha tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Enah challa. dereshit arisotechem ketiv:
Vegazel beyad kohen. vetzarich lehachazirah labbealim, sheim tishshaer beyado yihye savur sheissato fetura:
Haissa atzmah. shehifrish challatah kemach chayyevet bachalla:
Vehakkemach. shebba leyad kohen betorat challa:
Im yesh bo chashshiur. chameshet revaim kemach, chayyevet bachalla:
Vaasura lezarim. kol hakkemach shebba leyad kohen, vechumra bealma hu, lefi sherau shebba leyad kohen, shello yomru rainu zar ochel challot:
Ukefashah zaken zar. chatafah zaken zar vaachalah:
Kilkel leatzmo. daachalah veianash:
Vetikken laacherim. sheacherim ochlin vetolin bo, umotzim petach lehattir, lefi sherauhu sheachal:
Hammeissa. kemach al gabbe mayim rotchim:

Hachalita. mayim rotchim al gabbe kemach, umeforash baggemara ditre tannae ninhu umi sheshshana zo lo shana zo, detanna echad tena meissa vehu haddin chalita, vesavar ben meissa ben chalita bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayyevin, veidach tanna, tena chalita vehu haddin meissa, vesavar ben chalita ben meissa bet shammay mechayyevim uvet hillel potrim. uleinyan pesak halacha ben meissa ben chalita im neefot battannur chayyavot bachalla, veim bammarcheshet o vammachavat uvechol davar shehaur overet tachtav peturot min hachalla:
Asaan leatzmo. letzorech todato uneziruto:
Patur. kevan degilgelan lekaddeshan, dichtiv arisotechem velo issat hekdesh:
Limkor bashshuk. livne adam shetztzerichim lechallot toda urekike nazir:
Chayyav. dechol lashshuk imloche mamlich, i mizbinna mizbinna, vei lo, achilna lehu ana:
Nidmea issatah. nitarev bah teruma befachot mimmea chullin:
Mishsheggilgela chayyevet. dechevan denitchayyeva vachalla kevar, tu lo faka al yede dimmua:
Ad shello gilgela tease vetuma. kevan daafillu im tease vetohora en hakkohen rashshay leachlah mippene safek shennolad bah, yachol letammeotah miyyad kodem gilgul:
Mishsheggilgela tease vetohora. im nolad bah safek leachar haggilgul asur letammeotah, dechullin hattevulim lechalla kechalla damu, uteruma teluya tzericha shimmur:

Shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero vechulei. ayde devae lemitne sefa adam shehaya mitkavven lachavero, tana resha nammi shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero. daafillu haya mitkavven laishsha, patur hashshor middeme veladot, sheen chayyav bidme veladot ella adam bilvad:

Im ken mishshehaishsha yoledet mashbachat. im ken dechach shamin kidkaamart, ishtachach delo yahev leh mide, shehare mishshehaishsha yoledet mashbachat, sheddameha pechutin limmacher kodem shetteled, shemmesukkenet hi lamut betzaar halleda:

Hayta shifcha venishtachrera. kelomar hayta meshuchreret nesua leger o leeved meshuchrar, o giyyoret nesua leechad mehen, umet habbaal, patur. dehammachazik benichse hagger shemmet veen lo yorshim, zacha, veze kodem lizkot bema shebbeyado. vehu haddin nammi leyisreelit hannesua leger umet hagger, defatur, deha deme veladot labbaal. ella mishshum distam meshuchreret vegiyyoret nesuot leger velimshuchrar, lehachi nakat shifcha vegiyyoret:

Veim higdish birshut baal hassade chayyav. baggemara moke la bevika, shergilin kullan laasot begoren echad, ze gedisho veze gedisho, umemannin shomer. vechevan sheamar hashshomer ayyel ugedosh, have keillu amar ayyel veentar lach. aval bishar bene adam, afillu higdish birshut en baal hassade chayyav, ad dimkabbel aleha netiruta:
Kofet. keli hameyuchad lishiva, veshel temara hu:
Shekkevao venidbach. beshurat habbinyan:
Bana alav velo kevao. kederech shehaummanim osim shebbonim kippa al gabbe nesarim veachar kach mesirim otam:

Tame. im yashav hazzav al habbinyan shealav, nitma hakkofet shettachat habbinyan, shehazzav metamme et hammishkav veet hammoshav shettachat even mesama. vechen keshekkevao velo vana alav veyashav hazzav alav keshehu kavua, tame, delo nitbattel behachi. aval keshekkevao uvana alav, batel legabbe chotel uchechotel dame:
Mappatz. kemin machtzelet asuya mikkanim o miggemi:
Al gabbe hakkorot. shel aliyya:

Maaziva. tit utzerorot shel avanim shennotnim al gabbe hattikra. vechol kamma shello kava hammappatz bakkorot veyashav hazzav al hammaaziva, nitma hammappatz shettachteha velo vatel mittorat keli, dei vae shakel leh. vechen im kevao velo natan alav maaziva veyashav hazzav alav, tame moshav. velo vatel ad sheyyikba veyitten alav hammaaziva:
Kederech kabbalatah. shuleha lematta:
Shello chederech kabbalatah. shuleha lemala:
Issat kelavim. naaset mikkemach, umursan harebe meorav bah:
Bizman sheharoim ochlim mimmenna. shello nitarev bah mursan kol kach:
Chayyevet bachalla. dechevan dechazya laroim lechem karinan bah:
Umearvin bah. eruve chatzerot, lehotzi min habbattim lechatzer:
Umishtattefin bah. shittufe mevoot, lehotzi min hachatzerot lammavoy:
Umevarchin aleha. birkat hammotzi:
Umezammenin aleha. shelosha sheachlu mimmenna keachat chayyavim lezammen:
Veneefet beyom tov. mishshum chelek roim:
Veadam yotze vah yede chovato befesach. layla rishona shechayyav leechol kazzayit matztza:
Enah chayyevet bachalla. dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) reshit arisotechem, shellachem chayyevet velo shel chayya:
Mittammea tumat ochalin. kevan deal yede haddechak neechelet laadam, mittammea, ad shettippasel milleechol lakkelev:

Im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher. im yesh lo kemach acher chutz meissa zo, mevi kemach keshiur sheim yetzarfennu lisor ze shechayyav bachalla yihye vo chameshet revaim shehu shiur challa, velash issa umearev im haissa sheyyesh bah hasseor, umotzi mimmenna keshiur challa shetztzarich lehaferish mechameshet revaim:
Veim lav. sheen lo kemach, motzi challa echad meesrim vearbaa al kol haissa, detevel oser bechol shehu bemino, venaaset kullah tevula lechalla:
Merubba. bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uvedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim. dichtiv (Shemot 22) al se al salma al kol aveda vegomer‏ yeshallem shenayim:
En haggonev achar haggannav vechulei. dichtiv (sham) vegunnav mibbet haish, velo mibbet haggannav:
Nachtom sheasa seor lechallek. veyesh bo kede chiyyuv challa, ella sheddato lemachro livne adam lechalleko lechamma issot, veen bechol chelek vechelek kashshiur:
Chayyav bachalla. sheddato im lo yimtza konim sheyyaasennu issa veyofe otah kullah keachat:
Learkah tehora. orech hakkane leorech hammachtzelet, tehora. delo chazya lishchiva, shehakkanim mazzikin lashshochev, velo chazya ki im lesikkuch:
Kemin chi. yevanit. shehi kemin 20‏ hafucha shellanu. kelomar, leolam hi temea ad sheyyimshoch hakkanim mishshelosha tzedadim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Asaam lerachbah. orech hakkane lerochav hammachtzelet:
Arbaa tefachim. kesheyyesh ben kane lekane arbaa tefachim, chazya lishkav ben shene hakkanim:
Nechleka lerachbah. venishberu hakkanim shellah lechetzi:
Rabbi yehuda metaher. delo chazya lishchiva. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hammattir rashe hammaadannim. minhag ose machtzelaot keshemmashlimin hammachtzelet nishar kemin melel, vegodlim oto vechol shene tefachim gedil echad vekoshro shello yissater haarig. veim nittar omed listira venitbattel mittorat keli utehora:
Maadannim. kesharim. kemo vayyelech elav agag maadannot (Shmuel 1 15), kelomar, kashur kederech shekkoshrim haasurim. vechen hatekashsher maadannot kima (Iyov 38):
Shehem shel shishsha tefachim. shene tefachim ben maadan lemaadan vetefach mikkan vetefach mikkan:
Mishshettikkannev. mishsheyyachtoch veyiktom rashe kerumim habboltim. vezo hi keniva:
Shor shennagach et happara. meubberet:
Venimtza ubbarah betziddah. met:
Veen yadua im ad shello negachah yalda. velo met mechamat hannegicha:
Im mishshennegachah. umechamat hannegicha hippilato:

Urevia nezek lavvalad. detam chayyav chatzi nezek, vehay valad muttal besafek hu, vecholkin. umatnitin sumechos hi deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin. aval chachamim omrim ze kelal gadol baddin, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahalacha kachachamim. vaafillu nizzak omer bari umazzik omer shemma, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya:

Vechen para shennagcha et hashshor vechulei‏ meshallem chatzi nezek min happara. im nimtzet happara, kedin tam shemmeshallem chatzi nezek miggufo. veim lo nimtzet happara, meshallem revia nezek min havvalad. sheim haya yadua shekkodem sheyyalda nagcha haya meshallem kol chatzi nezek min havvalad, shemmeubberet shennagcha hi veubbarah nagchu. veim leachar sheyyalda nagcha lo haya meshallem min havvalad kelum, shehare havvalad lo nagach veen hattam meshallem ella miggufo. achshav shehu besafek, cholkim, umin hachatzi nezek sheyyesh lo leshallem meshallem revia nezek min havvalad:
Getz. nitzotz shel esh:
Rabbi yehuda omer bener chanukka patur. kevan divmitzva ka asek. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haya aviv o veno. shel baal habbayit betocho. vehu haddin lishar anashim, ella orcha demilleta nakat:
